name: Government Requests for User Information
description: Government requests to disclose user data (legal process). Counts per country, type of legal process, and compliance rate.

data.summary: Legal process requests to disclose user data. Majority are US-origin search warrants and subpoenas.
key_facts: US accounts for ~50% of all requests by volume.
Google discloses data in ~70-80% of cases with valid legal process.
Emergency disclosure requests have risen sharply since 2019.
